idea: Substitute the given values to obtain i(2 − I) = 1 + I. Show that the proposed value has the same product with the nonzero factor 2 − I, then divide.
proof:
have hz : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
    norm_num at hr
  have he : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    rw [← h₂, ← h₀, h₁]
  calc
    i = (i * (2 - Complex.I)) / (2 - Complex.I) := by
      field_simp
    _ = (1 + Complex.I) / (2 - Complex.I) := by rw [he]
    _ = 1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I := by
      apply (div_eq_iff hz).2
      linear_combination (3 / 5 : ℂ) * Complex.I_mul_I
